notes.title: ¡New Game!
notes.content:
Step into the shoes of a young photographer tasked with documenting the macabre. Explore a haunting world filled with secrets, solve chilling puzzles, and confront your deepest fears as you unravel a terrifying mystery.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590220/The_Blogger_Pumpkins_and_Witches/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590220/The_Blogger_Pumpkins_and_Witches/[/url]

notes.title: Appears in the credits
notes.content:
[h1]Hey[/h1]

From [b]June 26, 2023 to July 2[/b], we will review the table and players who get 1000 points and post the secret photo* in the screenshots section will appear in the credits!



*Secret Photo* The secret photo is the photo you get the first time you close the game







[list]
[*]We will take into account the use of software to edit the score, so they will be banned if they are used.
[/list]
